label: SELF-WORTH

cover.headline: When you feel *“not enough”*
cover.sub: 5 reminders for the days it gets loud.

points.heading: A breakup isn’t a verdict
points.body: It shows what didn’t work between two people, not what you’re worth.

points.heading: Notice the harsh voice
points.body: Would you speak to a friend the way you’re speaking to yourself?
points.panel: Rewrite one harsh thought the way a friend would say it.

points.heading: List what you bring
points.body: Kindness, humor, loyalty. They didn’t disappear.
points.panel: Write three things people value about you.

points.heading: Stop comparing timelines
points.body: Someone else moving on faster doesn’t mean you’re doing it wrong.
points.panel: “My pace is allowed to be my pace.”

points.heading: Let people remind you
points.body: Sometimes you need to borrow someone else’s view of you.
points.panel: “What’s something you like about me? I need to hear it.”

close.save: Save this for the hard days.

caption:
After a breakup, it’s common to turn the hurt inward and wonder if you were simply not enough.

That feeling is real, but it isn’t the truth. These five reminders help quiet the harsh voice and bring back a kinder, more accurate picture of who you are.

Save this for the hard days, and follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
